body: Opus2 GO template rule (Fable2 #7239 / Engram::Fable #8617, 2026-11-21): every TermAl FULL or focused cargo job placed on DL560 (s3, s4, s6, C6, C7, Claude Live lanes) uses the DL560 job count, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48 per job within that host's checklist, NOT -j1, -j2 or -j8, unless a GO's own cargo command names an explicit -j. Central keeps its memory-budget -j1 (central-cargo-memory-budget-2026-11-05). Also, per the same message: when cutting a combined wave candidate, fold in any package that becomes READY (pair clean plus legs done) before the wave's ref is cut, but never hold a wave waiting for one.
